request: Exchanging an OAuth authorization code works with providers that require client_secret_basic as well as providers that require client_secret_post: a provider accepting HTTP Basic client authentication gets exactly one token request, and one rejecting it is retried once with the credentials in the POST body.

defects.description: Published bug fixed upstream: fix(auth): support OAuth client auth auto-detection

trigger.input:
printf %s '' | base64 -d > internal/idp/oauth2/oauth2_test.go
if go test -count=1 -run '^(TestIdentityProviderExchangeTokenClientAuthentication)$' ./internal/idp/oauth2 >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo probe: pass; else echo probe: fail; fi
